title: End of workday
desc: Helps you close the day: what's still open, the week on Fridays, then you're free

variables.name: shutdown_requested
variables.desc: set to start the ritual (a program, or you)

variables.name: shutdown_day
variables.desc: the day the workday was last shut down (minutes since 1970, as today)

variables.name: next_task
variables.desc: the task to start with, as the planner says it

variables.name: shutdown_change
variables.desc: what you said you'd do differently next week (on a Friday)

signals.name: shutdown_done
signals.desc: whether today's work is shut down

variables.name: checked
variables.desc: when the rules last had a chance to offer it

variables.name: line
variables.desc: the last thing still open you wrote (none: that's all)

rules.name: late
rules.desc: past 18:00, more and more surely as the evening goes on

rules.name: low_focus
rules.desc: focus is low, a good moment to stop

idle.desc: waiting for the workday to wind down

next.desc: a workday, at work, every 5 minutes

deciding.desc: the rules' chance to offer it

ask_usr.context: Looks like your day is winding down. Want to wrap up? It takes a minute, and then you're free.
ask_usr.title: Wrap up?

do.name: nudged
do.desc: quiet for a while now, longer if it went unanswered

set.name: nudged_at
set.expr: time + (nudge_gap if answer is None else 0)

ask_usr.context: Anything still on your mind? Write it down and it'll be waiting tomorrow, so you can let it go tonight.
ask_usr.title: Still open

closing_week.desc: the week, on its last workday

ask_usr.context: One more, since it's Friday: looking back at this week, what's one thing you'd do differently next week?
ask_usr.title: This week

summary.desc: today's deep work, and tomorrow's first task

context.format: {h:.1f} h of deep work today. {first} Enjoy your evening.

values.first: 'Tomorrow starts with ' + next_task + '.' if next_task else 'Tomorrow is a clean slate.'
